verdict.rationale: Render's own site directly claims load-based autoscaling that handles 100x traffic bursts, and an independent community comment confirms Render supports autoscaling. The evidence is a marketing tagline, not in-depth documentation. missing for 10: detailed docs on autoscaling configuration (metrics, thresholds, min/max instances, scale-up speed), and hands-on evidence of absorbing real bursts.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on load-based autoscaling to absorb large traffic bursts automatically

citations.quote: Load-based autoscaling that handles 100x traffic bursts and beyond
they support distributed Elixir out of the box as well as autoscaling
